title: Carved on His Hands
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Some people thought the Lord had left,
"He has forgotten me."
He asked, "Could any mother leave
The baby on her knee?"

[Chorus]
I'm carved upon His open hands,
He cannot lose my name;
When nobody remembers me,
He loves me just the same.

[Verse 2]
"And even if a mother could,
I never will," said He;
"Look, I have carved you on My palms,
Right where I always see."

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
A new boy stood beside the fence,
Alone and feeling small;
Then Willow sat down close to him,
Not lonely after all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Your name is written on His hands,
He sees you all night through;
So rest your head, my darling child,
He's not forgetting you.

[Chorus]
mood: Lap music. A slow, unhurried rock from side to side under the voice, the sway of a grandmother holding a child on her lap, every line landing softly on the same gentle beat. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeping the sway, one low note held under each chorus like an open hand that stays. It grows quieter and surer with every verse, until the last chorus is almost spoken.
